units.source_text: 来到喷泉附近，春风轻轻吹拂过来，四处飞溅起小小的水沫。

en.t: As they came near the fountain, a spring breeze blew softly toward them, scattering tiny sprays of water all around.

units.source_text: 喷泉的左边，修建了一间相当大的钢筋玻璃圆屋顶温室。

en.t: To the left of the fountain stood a rather large greenhouse with a reinforced frame, glass walls, and a rounded roof.

units.source_text: 他们三人没有进去，只是隔着玻璃观赏各种热带植物，因为他们散步的时间很短。

en.t: The three of them did not go inside, but only admired the various tropical plants through the glass, because their time for walking was short.

units.source_text: 路的右边，挺拔的雪杉正在抽芽，下层的枝丫贴近地面伸展开去。

en.t: On the right side of the path, tall upright Himalayan cedars were putting out new buds, their lower branches spreading close along the ground.

units.source_text: 它虽是针叶树，但那新芽却悠悠地翠绿，一般来说是不会使人联想到“针”字的。

en.t: Although it was a conifer, its new buds were a soft, lingering green, and generally did not make one think of the word needle.

units.source_text: 它和落叶松不同，不是落叶树种。

en.t: Unlike the larch, it was not a deciduous tree.

units.source_text: 假使是落叶松，是不是也有令人着迷的嫩芽呢？

en.t: If it were a larch, would it too have enchanting young buds?
